reason: No repeatable outer numeric benefit or early wrapper return in 12 trials. Explicit naming selected for clarity, not demonstrated savings. One selected-condition trial had an extra process wait near completion; its outer wrapper did not return early. All initial exec calls independently chose 30000.
selection_scope: Remove redundant per-tool numbers; retain common 45-second ceiling. This does not establish statistical equivalence or an optimum.
naming_caveat: Named variants selected 40000-ms continuation waits in 3/6 trials; unnamed variants selected 44000 in all 6. Naming may indirectly affect inner wait selection; its cost effect is unresolved.
